title: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation (CTSH) Stock Price, News, Quote & History - Yahoo! Finance Canada
Deutsche Bank cautious on Cognizant, says growth thesis hasn’t played out
summary: Investing.com -- Deutsche Bank downgraded Cognizant Technology Solutions (NASDAQ: CTSH) to Hold from Buy and cut its price target to $66 in a new note, citing less confidence in the IT services company’s ability to improve organic revenue growth in the near term.
